name: MANISH SURESHKUMAR
bio:
Career Overview: Playing Style: A resilient baseliner with a strong forehand, consistent serve, and mental toughness, effective on clay and hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to play in a Grand Slam main draw.
Notable Achievements: ITF Titles: Won 4 ITF Futures singles titles (2018 Sri Lanka F1, 2021 Indore M15, 2022 Colombo M15, 2025 Bhopal M25) and 1 doubles title (2022 M15 New Delhi). Biggest Singles Win: Defeated World No. 219 Steven Diez at the 2018 ITF M15 Hua Hin. National Success: Two-time Khelo India Youth Games gold medalist (2019 singles, team) and double gold at the 2019 South Asian Games (singles, team). Davis Cup & National Representation: Yet to debut in Davis Cup but a frequent contender in Indian pro circuits.
Other Highlights: Reached the quarterfinals of the 2025 Bengaluru Open Challenger as a wildcard. Overcame early career financial struggles to establish himself as a top-10 Indian player (2019-2020). Aims for a Top 200 ranking.
Manish’s blend of grit and skill marks him as a steady presence in Indian tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
